title: pocketqube-fsm: configuration-driven, model-checked decision engine for PocketQube deployment and downlink scheduling
description: Code, configurations and evidence for the paper "Mission-agnostic mode management for PocketQubes: a configuration-driven, model-checked decision engine for deployment and downlink scheduling". Includes the Python engine and three YAML mission configurations, the POQUITO-based simulation, the policy comparison, generated TLA+ specifications, the 1,213-test suite, the Zephyr C port for STM32F401RE, and the archived Renode replay logs (35,763 decisions, no mismatches).
